coverage.pairing_rule: Each finite search cell must be captured once for each authored runtime suffix; suffix-specific Euler observations are recorded independently and are not assumed mirrored.
coverage.completeness_rule: Observed unique keys must equal the exact Cartesian product of the predeclared manifest (object_id, search_cell_id) and authored suffixes [l, r], with no missing or duplicate records.

research_basis.title: ISB recommendation on definitions of joint coordinate systems, Part II: shoulder, elbow, wrist and hand
research_basis.use: Coordinate reporting basis only; model landmarks and segment frames remain unbound.

research_basis.title: Initiation and development of fingertip forces during whole-hand grasping
research_basis.use: Motivates per-digit contact timing and force evidence; geometric capture cannot substitute for force transducers.

research_basis.title: Integration of marker and force data to compute three-dimensional joint moments of thumb and index during pinch
research_basis.use: Motivates aligned digit/object frames, joint centres and synchronized contact-force evidence.

research_basis.title: Quantifying Digit Force Vector Coordination during Precision Pinch
research_basis.use: Motivates contact locations, vector directions and centre-of-pressure evidence; no population mean is used as a limit.
